# hol+ Functional Medicine

> > Root cause functional medicine combining Ayurveda, Chinese medicine, and Western medicine for chronic conditions and holistic wellness.

hol+ is a functional medicine practice led by Dr. Taz Bhatia and team that specializes in treating chronic conditions through an integrative approach. The practice offers telehealth consultations, personalized treatment protocols including the Power RX® methodology, and services spanning autoimmune, cardiovascular, digestive, and metabolic health.
